blocks.html: Push your drone feed to the whole team, grab stills, and record video to your device straight from the UAS Tool toolbar.

slides.title: Open Drone Utilities
slides.html: Tap the Drone Utilities wrench icon on the lower toolbar to open the capture tools: Broadcast Video, Map Shot, Drone Shot, Record Video and Platform Settings.

slides.title: Broadcast video to the team
slides.html:
Tap Broadcast ON to stream the feed to other TAK users over Wi-Fi or tactical radio.

  • The button turns green when the stream is live.
  • Teammates open it with Video on the UAS map marker radial.

slides.title: Set up the broadcast
slides.html: Long-press Broadcast On to open the broadcast settings. Set the Broadcast Size, Broadcast Bitrate and Video Broadcast Destination to match your network.

slides.title: Drop a Mapshot on the map
slides.html: Tap Mapshot to grab the current feed image and drop it as a picture marker on the map. A prompt lets you send it to the team, and it lands at the spot the drone was looking at.

slides.title: Take a Drone Shot still
slides.html: Tap the Drone Shot icon to capture a still straight from the platform's sensor and save it to the device.

slides.title: Record video locally
slides.html:
Tap Record Video to start and stop recording the incoming feed.

  • Clips save to the EUD and show up in ATAK's Video Player.
  • Long-press the button to record to the EUD, the drone's SD card, or both.
